verses.gurmukhi: ਨਥਿ ਚਲਾਏ ਨਵੈ ਨਾਥਿ ਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਹਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: nath chalaae navai naath naathaa naath anaath sahaiee|

en.bdb: Though, the gurmukh subdues the nine naths (ascetic yogis) yet he considers himself as without any father i.e. most humble, and God as the father of the fatherless ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਫੁਰਮਾਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: nau nidhaan furamaan vich param nidhaan giaan gurbhaiee|

en.bdb: Nine treasures are in his command and the great ocean of knowledge goes with him like his brother.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: nau bhagatee nau bhagat kar gurmukh prem bhagat liv laiee|

en.bdb: Neo devotees practice nine types of ritualistic devotion but gurmukh remains immersed in the loving devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਾਧ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: nau gireh saadh girahasat vich poore satigur dhee vaddiaaiee|

en.bdb: With the blessings of the Guru and living the household life, he controls all the nine planets.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉਖੰਡ ਸਾਧ ਅਖੰਡ ਹੋਇ ਨਉ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਲੰਘਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: naukha(n)dd saadh akha(n)dd hoi nau dhuaar la(n)gh nij ghar jaiee|

en.bdb: Even conquering the nine divisions of earth, he never gets broken up and, going above the illusions of nine doors of  body, he comes to reside in his own self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਅੰਗ ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਹੋਇ ਨਉ ਕੁਲ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: nau a(n)g neel aneel hoi nau kul nigreh sahaj samaiee|

en.bdb: From nine numbers have been  counted infinite numbers, and controlling the nine pleasures (ras) in the body, gurmukh stays in the equipoise.
Only gurmukhs receive the unattainable fruit of the supreme delight.
